story: Morning bed selfie in unbuttoned oversized white shirt revealing lace undergarments.
prompt: An alluring first-thing selfie from bed in Seongsu, Seoul. A 26-year-old athletic Korean woman sitting on white linen sheets, wearing an oversized crisp white cotton shirt completely unbuttoned and slipping off her bare shoulders, revealing a delicate black lace bra underneath, bare collarbones and long bare legs. Soft warm morning backlighting making the white cotton glow, loose messy hair falling over one cheek, relaxed sleepy half-smile looking into the camera. Arm's length front camera selfie: 23mm equivalent lens, subtle lens noise, real skin texture with small freckles across the bridge of her nose.
caption: woke up slow today. linen sheets and morning sun... felt like sharing this side of me with you ✨
